summary: A conifer with a flared root collar, a leaning tapered bole and eight whorls, each a skirt with nine boughs poking past it, with sway(dt) and an instancing handle.
objective: At six metres the conifer reads as a narrow leaning cone with a bare bole, then eight separate whorls, then countable boughs, facets and hue jitter.
example_prompts: Put a line of conifers along the ridge behind the village.
I need a pine that does not look like a stack of party hats.
not_for: Any claim about a conifer species, its habit or its timber.
Needle-level foliage: a bough is a flattened cone, not a needle system.

silhouette: a narrow leaning cone 5.1 m tall over a bare bole for its lowest sixth
a leader spike standing clear above the top whorl
five root wedges splaying out of the base
medium: eight whorls of decreasing radius, each turned to its own angle
the bole visible between the upper whorls, tapering from 16 cm to 3 cm
a skirt of needle mass inside every whorl, with boughs poking past its rim
fine: nine countable boughs in every whorl, each at its own reach and droop
flat-shaded facets on every bough and skirt, so the crown catches light in planes
per-bough hue jitter of 10 percent across the seventy-two boughs

principles: Countable boughs are what separate a spruce from a stack of cones at any distance closer than twenty metres.
The bare bole under the lowest whorl is the read that says conifer even when the crown is a silhouette against fog.
One bough geometry, seventy-two instances: the variation lives in the placement, not in seventy-two meshes.
implementation: Call create({ seed, age, lean, height, radius, needle }); the group is centred on the bole base with y = 0 at the ground.
animate(dt) - also exported as sway(dt) - rocks the crown and returns true when it moved; it returns false for dt <= 0.
instancing gives { geometry, material, hueJitter } for the bough, laid along +X with its butt at the origin so a placement is an azimuth and a droop.
observable_checks: Run scripts/kit-proof.py and count features in close.png: at least two from each detail-ladder band must be visible.
lean 0.3 moves the leader socket more than 30 cm further off axis than lean 0.
animate(0) returns false and animate(0.4) returns true and moves the crown.

known_limits: Authored creative geometry. Nothing here measures a real conifer or its species habit.
The poly budget is the triangle count observed at default parameters and stays inside the 2500 triangle ceiling this phase set for nature.
Boughs are opaque flattened cones with no needle silhouette: at less than a metre the crown reads as folded card.
sway() rotates the whole crown group, so the boughs move together rather than each bough loading independently.

Palette values are the colours that render: kit-core scatterInstances runs its InstancedMesh on a white-based clone of the material and writes the absolute jittered colour per instance, so an unjittered instance lands on exactly the hex the parameter names.
creative_affordances: Any parameter may be pushed outside its stated range; the range is the band that was proved, not a limit.
Drop age and raise lean for a treeline krummholz, or re-colour the needle to a blue-grey for a spruce stand.

defaults.rationale: 5.1 m keeps a conifer taller than every building in the village kit, which is what makes a ridge line of them read as distance rather than as scale confusion.
